look: 手工毛毡玩偶定格动画风格，绒面毛毡质感，柔和高光与浅景深微距感。
setting: 角色1被锁在画面中央，脖子上的金属链连着身后木桩上的挂锁；其余角色先后从画面右侧走入，地上的筹码铺在角色1与画面右边缘之间。
scene: 桌面微缩布景：麻布台面上铺着一块暗红色地毯，地毯周围立着几盏彩色的小蘑菇灯。
light_text: 夜里的桌面微缩布景，唯一光源是布景中几盏小蘑菇灯的暖橙色柔光，光线柔和温暖，背景自然虚化。
constraints: 全片四段生成，依次对应漫画四格，顺序不可调。第一段只有角色1，他在原地挣扎并大喊。第二段角色2提篮从右侧走入，看也不看被锁住的角色1，宣布抄底后蹲下捡筹码，角色1在她身后继续哭喊。第三段角色3提篮走入并喊出更低的价位后也蹲下捡筹码，角色2抱着满篮筹码崩溃大哭。第四段角色5与角色4先后走入排进队伍，角色4念完台词后硬切到全景（约在第四段3秒处），露出越排越长的队伍，最后角色4蹲下把地上仅剩的筹码扫进篮子，循环闭合。每段第一拍安排进场动作，台词与捡筹码的节拍必须完整落在续接重叠之后。角色1脖子上的铁链与挂锁全片只此一副，链子自然垂挂，位置不变；每个竹篮只属于一名持有者，筹码不换手。哭喊短促，不拖长气声；角色2与角色3的喊话是兴奋而不是怒斥，语速偏快。不出现字幕、气泡、文字与额外角色。
source_script:
角色1动作：角色1猛地向前一扑，伸出一只爪子去够地上的筹码。
角色1：啊啊啊！
角色2入场：角色2提着一个竹篮从画面右侧走进空地，从角色1身旁走过，看都不看他一眼。
角色2：市场血流成河，正是抄底好时机！
角色1：啊啊啊！
角色2动作：角色2蹲下身，把竹篮口贴着地面，一枚一枚把筹码拨进篮子里。
角色3入场：角色3提着一个竹篮走进画面，在角色2身旁停下。
角色3：跌到二十五了，遍地黄金！
角色3动作：角色3也蹲下来，把地上的筹码一枚一枚拨进自己的竹篮。
角色1动作：角色1在原地拼命前扑，爪子够不到筹码，泪水从脸上滑下来。
角色2：啊啊啊！
角色2动作：角色2抱起装满筹码的竹篮贴在胸前，篮子里的筹码从篮口溢出来。
角色5入场：角色5跟在角色3身后走进来，一句话也不说。
角色4入场：角色4提着一个竹篮走到队伍最前面，在地上那堆筹码旁边停住。
角色4：……市场血流成河，恐慌情绪蔓延。
角色1动作：角色1被锁在队伍最后面，挣扎着往前扑，泪水糊了脸。
角色1：啊啊啊！
角色2动作：角色2抱着满篮筹码站在队伍里，低着头。
角色3动作：角色3提着装满筹码的竹篮站在队伍里，看着地面。
角色5动作：角色5站在队伍里，空着双手，安安静静地等着。
角色4动作：角色4蹲下身，把竹篮口伸向地上仅剩的几枚筹码。

execution.look: Handmade felt-puppet stop-motion style, fuzzy felt surface texture, soft highlights and a shallow-focus macro feel.
execution.setting: Character 1 is locked at the center of the frame, the metal chain around the neck running back to a padlock on a wooden stake behind; the other characters walk in from the right one after another, and the chips lie on the ground between Character 1 and the right edge of the frame.
execution.scene: A tabletop miniature set: a dark red rug laid over a burlap cloth surface, with a few small colorful mushroom lamps standing around it.
execution.light: A tabletop miniature set at night, lit only by the warm orange glow of small mushroom lamps inside the set; the light is soft and warm and the background falls out of focus.
execution.visible_state: Character 1 stands at the center of the frame, leaning forward with one paw holding a small woven basket at the side and the other paw stretched down toward the colored chips scattered on the ground; a single metal chain runs from the collar around the neck to one padlock fastened to a short wooden stake behind, and tears run down the face. Character 2, Character 3 and Character 4 each carry one woven basket of their own, and each basket stays with the character who holds it. The lineup and the filled baskets follow the ordered actions.

directions.event_001: Character 1 leans far forward from the waist, one paw stretched down toward the colored chips on the ground while the other paw holds the small woven basket at the side; the single chain at the neck runs back to the one padlock on the wooden stake, and the open mouth trembles as tears slide down the face.
directions.event_003: Character 2 walks in from the right edge of the frame carrying one woven basket in a paw, steps past Character 1 while keeping the eyes on the chips ahead, and stops at the edge of the scattered chips.
directions.event_006: Character 2 squats down, pushes the mouth of the woven basket along the ground and sweeps the scattered chips into it one by one until a small heap of chips sits inside.
directions.event_007: Character 3 walks in from the right carrying one woven basket and stops beside Character 2, looking down at the chips on the ground.
directions.event_009: Character 3 squats down next to Character 2 and sweeps the chips on the ground into the woven basket with a paw.
directions.event_010: Character 1 keeps straining forward from the same spot, paws lifted toward the chips, tears running down the face and the mouth open wide.
directions.event_012: Character 2 lifts the loaded woven basket against the chest, chips spilling over the rim, and looks up with the face wet and the mouth open.
directions.event_013: Character 5 walks in from the right at the back of the group and stops behind the others in a queue, standing quietly with empty paws.
directions.event_014: Character 4 walks in from the right carrying one woven basket and stops at the front of the queue, closest to the chips on the ground.
directions.event_016: Character 1 thrashes where the chain holds him at the back of the queue, paws scraping at the ground and the mouth wide open, the chain and padlock staying fastened behind.
directions.event_018: Character 2 stands in the line holding the loaded woven basket against the chest with the head lowered.
directions.event_019: Character 3 stands in the line holding a woven basket filled with chips, looking down at the ground.
directions.event_020: Character 5 stands in the line with empty paws, the head turned toward the front of the line.
directions.event_021: Character 4 squats down at the front of the line, pushes the woven basket along the ground and gathers the last few chips into it.
